findings.title: Every component carries a package URL
findings.detail: 1 of 9 components has no purl; VEX statements cannot reference them unambiguously.

findings.title: Components identify their supplier
findings.detail: 1 of 9 components name no supplier, author or publisher.

findings.title: No vulnerability is left under investigation at release
findings.detail: 1 finding is still under_investigation. That is an honest state to ship, but it must be closed before the technical file is signed.

findings.title: Package ecosystems are within the tested coverage
findings.detail: npm: 3, golang: 2, maven: 2, pypi: 1, unknown: 1. Ecosystems outside golang/maven/npm are reported but not covered by the fixed-price scope.

findings.title: Components carry integrity hashes
findings.detail: 2 of 9 components carry a hash. Hashes are not required by the CRA but make the SBOM verifiable against the shipped artefact.

findings.title: SBOM is in a commonly used machine-readable format
SBOM names the product it describes
SBOM records when it was produced
SBOM records who or what produced it
findings.detail: syft 1.18.1, Acme Software GmbH Release Engineering

findings.title: Known vulnerabilities are enumerated
findings.detail: grype 0.87.0 scanned the product: Critical: 1, High: 3, Medium: 1

findings.title: Every known vulnerability has a documented decision
findings.detail: All 5 findings are covered by a VEX statement.
